rent.description: Houses earn rent via signed contracts. Collect when ready; missing collect triggers lost-rent state.

houseBonus.description: Decorations within influenceRadiusTiles add houseBonusScaled to house influence.

wonders.description: cityBonusScaled; 500 ~= 5% city-wide. Also produce gold every 8h and diamonds every 24h (1 each by default).

commerce.description: Commerces earn cash on a fixed rewardSec cycle. Payout scales with construction cost (same timer/collect loop as houses).
